4	# Runs first. When the request carries an 'Idempotency-Key' already seen, publish the

6	# publish the key (possibly absent) and continue to validate.

8	  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CheckIdempotentCreate
9	  govern: [ transaction ]
10	  next: validate
11	  outputs:
12	    existing: respondExisting
13	
14	# Respond 200 with the originally created owner for a repeated idempotent create.
15	respondExisting:
16	  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RespondWithOwner
17	  govern: [ transaction ]
18	
19	# Validate before Build so a missing or blank field is a 400 naming the offending
20	# fields, and the body is read (and republished) exactly once here.
21	validate:
22	  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateOwnerFields
23	  govern: [ transaction ]
24	  next: ensureUniqueIdentity
25	
26	# Reject creating an owner whose identityKey (SHA-256 over normalizedTelephone|lowerEmail|
27	# soundex(lastName)) equals an existing non-deleted owner's, responding 409. Runs after
28	# validate so the email-domain blocklist and telephone normalization are already applied.
29	# This is the single duplicate-detection check; there is no separate household-duplicate block.
30	ensureUniqueIdentity:
31	  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureUniqueOwnerIdentity
32	  govern: [ transaction ]
33	  next: ensureCityCapacity
34	
35	# Reject creating an owner when the request's city already contains 50 or more owners,
36	# responding 409.
37	ensureCityCapacity:
38	  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureCityCapacity
39	  govern: [ transaction ]
40	  next: ensureDailyCreateLimit
41	
42	# Reject creating an owner once 100 or more owners have already been created today
43	# (by registrationDate), responding 429.

46	  govern: [ transaction ]
47	  next: build

49	build:
50	  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.BuildOwner
51	  govern: [ transaction ]
52	  next: assignMemberId
53	
54	# Assign the '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>' memberId: REGION is the region derived from the
55	# postcode, FY is the two-digit fiscal year of the registrationDate, HASH8 is the first 8
56	# upper-hex chars of SHA-256(normalizedTelephone + lastName) and CHK is a single Luhn check
57	# digit over the digits of <REGION><FY><HASH8>. A stable identity with no sequence number.
58	assignMemberId:
59	  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignOwnerMemberId
60	  govern: [ transaction ]
61	  next: assignHousehold
62	
63	# Stamp the deterministic householdId (first 12 hex of SHA-256 of normalizedLastName|postcode)
64	# so owners with the same lastName + postcode share it automatically. Null when no postcode.

67	  govern: [ transaction ]

79	  govern: [ transaction ]

82	# Record the new owner against its 'Idempotency-Key' (if any) so a later repeat with the
83	# same key returns this owner instead of creating a duplicate. Runs after Save so the id exists.
84	recordIdempotency:
85	  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RecordIdempotentCreate
86	  govern: [ transaction ]
87	  next: audit
88

92	  govern: [ transaction ]

98	  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.NotifyWelcome
99	  govern: [ transaction ]
100	  next: warn

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The optional honorific title of the pet owner. When supplied it drives the derived salutation. One of MR, MRS, MS or DR.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. When structured address fields are supplied, this is the composed address (the normalized addressLine1, with a single space and the normalized addressLine2 appended when addressLine2 is present); otherwise it is the normalized flat address. Accepted on input for backward compatibility.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the owner's structured postal address. Preferred over the flat address when present. Normalized like address.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address. Normalized like address and, when present, appended to addressLine1 (single space) to form the composed address.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Unit 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Stored and returned in E.164 form.

I implemented the `riskFlag` feature following the established derived-flag pattern (mirroring `capacityWarning`/`possibleDuplicate`). `riskFlag` is `true` when **any** of the three signals holds, else `false`:

1. **Possible duplicate** — reads `owner.getPossibleDuplicate()`, set by the prior `possibleDuplicate` step.

- **`officefloor/rest/api/owners.POST.yml`** and **`owners/{ownerId}.GET.yml`** — inserted an `assignRiskFlag` step after `possibleDuplicate` (before `respond`), under the pipeline's `transaction` / `readonly-transaction` governance, so create and GET responses compute the same value.
